svg.title: Improvado MCP: your marketing data, in the AI client you already use
svg.desc: Improvado MCP: your marketing data, in the AI client you already use. A hosted MCP server; sign in with your Improvado account, then ask questions in Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, Gemini CLI or Codex about the channels connected to your workspace. Illustrated with an example prompt, 'Compare ad spend by channel for the last 30 days', and source chips for Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Google Analytics 4 and HubSpot.
